name: udp_ingress_handler
description: Boundary gateway receiving external UDP datagrams, wrapping them into MessageEnvelope frames with client metadata, and pushing into internal pipeline channels.

outputs.name: output_channel
outputs.label: Pipeline Egress
outputs.description: Internal pipeline channel receiving encapsulated ingress frames.

ingress.host.label: Listen Host Address
ingress.host.description: IP interface on which to bind and listen for UDP traffic.

ingress.port.label: Listen Port
ingress.port.description: UDP port number to listen on.

ingress.buffer_size.label: Socket Buffer Size (bytes)
ingress.buffer_size.description: Operating system kernel socket receive buffer size.

protocol.name: udp
protocol.doc: Network transport metadata captured by UDP Ingress and restored at UDP Egress.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.doc: Originating client IPv4 address (network byte order integer or dotted quad string)

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.doc: Target / ingress IPv4 address (network byte order integer)

fields.name: address_family
fields.doc: IP address family (4 for IPv4, 6 for IPv6)
